De Quervain’s can cause sharp thumb and wrist pain that makes everyday tasks difficult. Learn what may be causing your pain and simple stretches, exercises, and treatment tips that can help relieve symptoms and improve movement.
Brad Heineck, the late Bob Schrupp, and their team created the most famous physical therapy channel, helping millions stay healthy, fit, and pain-free. Bob’s mission lives on through his children and the Bob & Brad team.
